emily: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem (3/20) — creating a short owner/handoff plan and validation window. Please claim tasks and add ETA. I'll keep a central tracker.

emily: Tickets: RDW-3001 (collision-resistant cache keys) https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RDW-3001
emily: RDW-3002 (burst-aware autoscaler policy) https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RDW-3002
emily: RDW-3003 (alerting + 30d correlation job for recurring 90m spikes) https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RDW-3003

rob: I'll own RDW-3001. Plan: add per-tenant prefixing + fuzz test for existing keys, add unit/integration tests, then staged rollout (shadow -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%). ETA: next Thu. Need QA to run fuzz harness. @claire can you cover QA?

claire: yep I can run the harness. Will add `cache-fuzz` job to CI. Also I'll mark RDW-3001 `qa-ready` when done.

emily: RACI RDW-3001: R=rob, A=emily, C=claire,sre_jordan, I=oncall-team

sre_jordan: Assigning RDW-3002 to myself. Early replay showed the scaler misses sub-1min bursts; I'll prototype a predictive warm pool + immediate short-lived burst pods. ETA: 10 days.

rachel: I'll pick RDW-3003. Plan: add a Grafana panel correlating cron timestamps with KV eviction rate and an automated alert when pattern matches 3 occurrences in 24h. Also write the short runbook for oncall. ETA: two weeks.

emily: Good. A few process rules:
- Every Jira must have clear acceptance criteria (gates for canary).
- Add a closure checklist in ticket (tests, canary watch, runbook entry, dashboard link).
- Owners should add a short 'handoff note' if they need to transfer ownership (who, why, expected handoff window).

rob: Example acceptance for RDW-3001: ```Acceptance: shadow mode for 48h without user-facing errors; staged rollout with canary watch at each stage; no increase in 5xx rate > 0.05%
```

claire: I'll add the CI job and the QA signoff template to the ticket.

oncall-bot: Incident resolved — follow-ups required. Please assign owners in the tickets.

emily: One additional item: ownership handoff rules. If owner will be unavailable >72h, they must assign a 'shadow owner' in Jira with a clear transfer plan. If blocked >48h, escalate to me. We'll also do a validation audit 30 days after closure to confirm regression didn't reappear.

rachel: noted — adding `30d-validation` checklist item to RDW-3003. Will ping owners when validation window starts.

sre_jordan: For coordination, propose labels: `pm-followup`, `needs-shadow`, `needs-validation`. Will add to tickets.

emily: Ok scheduling: weekly sync Fridays 9am until all follow-ups are closed. I'll create the recurring invite. Also I'll post a mid-cycle snapshot in #postmortem-followups on Wed.

rob: tagging runbook templates and canary playbook in RDW-3001 now.

emily: thanks all — I'll update the tracker. Close thread for now, reopen with progress notes. :wave:
